criterion_scores.reasoning: The v0.8 additions accurately implement the YED-103 charter: mission/persona/counterweight, the three floors (Receipts/HM-Activation/Anti-Goodhart), the softened Tone Pillar 5, close-is-self-trap, and the Learn-More Set are all present and logically sound. The 'ordering not erasure' counterweight is stated precisely (audience-first governs sequence, not presence) and doesn't misstate or overreach the charter's intent.

All charter elements present, none stubbed. But the counterweight is cross-referenced only from Tone Pillar 5; the pre-existing Decenter-the-Self section and the Opener rule -- the two rules most likely read in isolation by a content skill -- are left unedited with no pointer to the counterweight, so a reader hitting those first would not know the 'claims it plainly' allowance exists. Also the three North-Star floors vs the separate Substance/Insight Floor share 'floor' terminology without a distinguishing note.

Correct .claude/references/ location, dated version-history footer convention followed exactly (new v0.8 entry appended, prior preserved), and the doc points to the canonical audience-north-star.md rather than duplicating it inline -- matching source-of-truth discipline. No naming/frontmatter violations.

Anti-Goodhart floor defines 'resonance' before measurement and ties it to a concrete downstream signal, avoiding the orphan-metric anti-pattern the value-action-registry warns against. HM-Activation framed as 'an output, not a hope'. No fabricated specificity, no resurrected tombstoned decisions, charter-driven not speculative.

Honest in tone -- defers to canonical audience-north-star.md rather than overclaiming inline, doesn't stamp anything 'verified' without basis. Docked slightly: the overlapping 'floor' terminology and the uneven cross-referencing of the counterweight are latent ambiguities a maintainer would untangle later, not flagged as known loose ends.
